identity.name: SmolLM2
identity.summary: SmolLM2 is a compact language model developed by Hugging Face, part of a family of efficient small models.

possible_risks.description: Lack of model transparency is due to insufficient documentation of the model design, development, and evaluation process and the absence of insights into the inner workings of the model.
possible_risks.justification: Card reports only architecture, training scale, and data categories; no evaluation results, intended-use restrictions, or inner-workings details are documented.

possible_risks.description: Lack of data transparency might be due to insufficient documentation of training or tuning dataset details, including synthetic data generation.
possible_risks.justification: Card says pretraining combined web text with math, code, and instruction data but does not document dataset compositions, proportions, or sources.

possible_risks.description: Data provenance refers to the traceability of data (including synthetic data), which includes its ownership, origin, transformations, and generation. Proving that the data is the same as the original source with correct usage terms is difficult without standardized methods for verifying data sources or generation.
possible_risks.justification: Open-weight Apache-2.0 checkpoint trained on ~11T tokens from unspecified web and specialized sources; no traceability of data ownership/origin is provided.

possible_risks.description: Since foundation models can be used for many purposes, a model's intended use is important for defining the relevant risks of that model. As the use changes, the relevant risks might correspondingly change.
possible_risks.justification: Card gives no intended-use or misuse guidance for the text-to-text model, leaving downstream risk scoping undefined.

specifications.model_size: 0.7 GiB of safetensors weights (723,674,912 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: The model was trained with a multi-stage pretraining approach rather than a fixed dataset mixture throughout pretraining.
training_context.training_data: SmolLM2 was pretrained on roughly 11 trillion tokens in a multi-stage process combining web text with specialized math, code, and instruction-following data.
